title: Detailed trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell of the trumpet -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='14' ry='22' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='10' ry='18' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='6' ry='14' fill='#7B4B00'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='3' ry='9' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Bell rim highlight -->
  <path d='M10 32 Q8 50 10 68' stroke='#FFF176' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Main body tube -->
  <rect x='34' y='46' width='40' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <rect x='34' y='47' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing block -->
  <rect x='48' y='38' width='16' height='24' rx='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='49' y='39' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Three valves -->
  <rect x='49' y='26' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <rect x='54' y='24' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='59' y='26' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  
  <!-- Valve tops (finger buttons) -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <!-- Valve button highlights -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='23' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='21' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='23' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  
  <!-- Valve stems connecting buttons to casing -->
  <rect x='50' y='28' width='2' height='10' fill='#BDBDBD'/>
  <rect x='55' y='26' width='2' height='12' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='28' width='2' height='10' fill='#BDBDBD'/>
  
  <!-- Tuning slide (loop above the main tube) -->
  <path d='M58 44 Q58 34 66 34 Q74 34 74 44' stroke='#FFCA28' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 44 Q58 36 66 36 Q74 36 74 44' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Third valve slide (loop below the main tube) -->
  <path d='M52 54 Q52 62 58 62 Q64 62 64 54' stroke='#FFCA28' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 54 Q52 60 58 60 Q64 60 64 54' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Leadpipe (mouthpiece end) -->
  <rect x='72' y='47' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='72' y='48' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='86' y='46' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='50' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='50' rx='1' ry='2.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <!-- Water key (spit valve) on third slide -->
  <line x1='58' y1='62' x2='58' y2='68' stroke='#BDBDBD' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='69' r='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  
  <!-- Brace (connector between main tube and bell) -->
  <rect x='32' y='44' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Finger ring decorations -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Bell interior glow -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='8' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Reflective highlights on body -->
  <rect x='36' y='48' width='10' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='55' y='48' width='6' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
